meta.what: Site verdicts for a landing at every hour: overall margin and failing criteria of the 14-day mission.
meta.method: pipeline/run_heatmap_hourly.py: the calculation of run_heatmap.py (moonkeeper_b.metrics) with a landing at every hour of the grid. Approach lighting is computed once a day (12:00 UTC landing); each hour uses the value of its UTC date.
meta.limits: Criteria are assumed values. The approach value is the daily one, so it does not follow the Sun within the day.
meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (SI) during the event; inputs are NASA LOLA + JPL Horizons.
